results.question: Need 40 ergonomic mesh chairs with 4D armrests in navy, under $350 each, delivered to Chicago within 3 days.
results.sql: SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.sku, o.quantity, o.order_date, o.promised_date, o.status, o.transit_delay_hr, o.depot_id FROM orders o JOIN products p USING (sku) WHERE p.category = 'Office chairs' AND p.name = 'Ergonomic Mesh Chair' AND p.armrests = '4D' AND p.color = 'Navy' AND p.unit_price < 350 AND o.quantity = 40 AND o.status = 'IN_TRANSIT' AND o.promised_date = DATE('now', '+3 days') AND o.depot_id IN (SELECT depot_id FROM delivery_times WHERE destination_city = 'Chicago' AND days = 3) LIMIT 50
